name: Compute Cluster S72: Advanced Cross-Sectional Transforms
description: Tests: cs_momentum(period), cs_quantile(q), cs_winsorize(lower, upper), cs_weighted_mean. Multi-asset universe scoring and percentile analysis.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S72: Advanced Cross-Sectional
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
volume = src.v

# === CS MOMENTUM: cumulative cross-sectional mean return ===
ret = returns(close)
mom = cs_momentum()(ret)

# === CS QUANTILE: median return across universe ===
ret_21 = returns(period=21)(close)
med_ret = cs_quantile(q=0.5)(ret_21)

# === CS WINSORIZE: cap cross-sectional outliers ===
clean_ret = cs_winsorize(lower_limit=0.05, upper_limit=0.95)(ret_21)

# === CS RANK for selection ===
ranked = cs_rank_quantile()(mom)
top_tercile = ranked > 0.67
bottom_tercile = ranked < 0.33

# === REPORTERS ===
cs_lines(
    title='Cross-Sectional Momentum Score (63d)',
    category='CS Momentum'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=mom)

cs_lines(
    title='21d Returns: Raw vs CS-Winsorized',
    category='CS Outliers'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=clean_ret)

cs_lines(
    title='CS Rank Quantile (Momentum)',
    category='CS Ranking'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ranked)
